*   `?g A6`: Main Concept is A6 (Cinema / Movie).
    *   `+ D5`: A cube on D5 (Death / Bad / Illness) in the same group (g).
        *   *Meaning so far:* A movie that is about death/bad/illness.
    *   `!r A10`: Red Sub-Concept pawn on A10 (Date / Event / Day).
    *   `+ D5`: A cube on D5 in the red group.
        *   *Meaning so far:* A movie related to an event/date involving death.
    *   `!y F11`: Yellow Sub-Concept pawn on F11 (One / Unit / Number).
    *   `+ G2`: Cube on G2 (Cross / Crossing / Addition) in the yellow group.
    *   `+ F11`: Cube on F11 in the yellow group.
        *   *Meaning so far:* A movie related to a date/event involving death, and it has something to do with the number "1" or "one" (F11) and addition/crossing (G2).

    *   *Category:* Movie.
    *   *Theme:* Death, bad, illness.
    *   *Event/Date:* A specific day or event.
    *   *Number/Math:* The number "1" (F11) and potentially "plus" or "crossing" (G2).
